<script>
(function () {
  var PERIOD = 1220;
  // t, hx,hy,hr,hsx,hsy, mx,my,mw,mh, ery,eo, bx,by,br,sx,sy, la,ra, blx,bly,bs, so, sq
  var K = [
    [0,     0,   0,   0, 1,    1,    0,   0,  1,    1,    0, 1,    0,   0,  0,   1,    1,    0,   0,    0,   0, 1,    0.45, 0],
    [180,  -8.5, 39,  0, 1.1,  0.8,  7.5, 4,  1.05, 0.85, -2, 1,  -5,   5,  0,   1.13, 0.83, 3.2, 0,   -2,  20, 0.85, 0.6,  1],
    [340,  -8,  -7,   0, 0.91, 0.92, 7,  -12, 0.93, 0.8,  -8, 0.6, -3,  0,  0,   0.87, 1.04, 5,  -5,   -9,  -6, 1.1,  0.35, 0],
    [520,  -25,  11, -10, 1,   1,    3,  -5,  0.95, 0.98,  0, 1,  -3,   0, -1.5, 1,    0.97, 0,  -1,   -6,  -2, 0.95, 0.45, 0],
    [680,  -31,  62, -4, 1.07, 0.78, 5,   1,  0.98, 0.92, -2, 1,  -2,   8,  0,   1.14, 0.8,  3.5, 4.5, -7,  21, 0.88, 0.6,  1],
    [860,  -18,  0,   0, 0.91, 0.92, 7,  -12, 0.93, 0.8,  -8, 0.6, -1,  0,  0,   0.9,  1.03, 7,  -2.5, -9,  -4, 1.04, 0.35, 0],
    [1020, -31,  19, -13, 1,   1,    0,  -5,  0.9,  0.98,  0, 1,  -3,   1, -2,   1,    0.95, 0,   0,   -6,  -1, 0.93, 0.45, 0.1],
    [1200, -37,  51, -20, 1.05, 0.85, 3,  0,  1.05, 0.92, -2, 1,  -4,   6, -2,   1.13, 0.79, 4,   3,   -9,  19, 0.86, 0.6,  1]
  ];

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  var el = {
    legs: $('legs'), legL: $('leg-left'), legR: $('leg-right'), pelvis: $('pelvis'),
    body: $('body'), clip: $('torso-clip-path'), belly: $('belly'),
    armL: $('arm-left'), armR: $('arm-right'), shadow: $('head-shadow-shape'),
    head: $('head'), eyes: $('eyes'), eyeR: $('eye-right'), mouth: $('mouth')
  };

  function f(v) { return (Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000).toString(); }

  function pose(t) {
    t = +t;
    if (!isFinite(t)) t = 0;
    t = ((t % PERIOD) + PERIOD) % PERIOD;
    var n = K.length, i = 0;
    while (i < n - 1 && t >= K[i + 1][0]) i++;
    if (i >= n - 1) return K[n - 1];
    var a = K[i], b = K[i + 1], u = (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0]), r = [t];
    for (var j = 1; j < a.length; j++) r.push(a[j] + (b[j] - a[j]) * u);
    return r;
  }

  function render(t) {
    var p = pose(t);
    var hx = p[1], hy = p[2], hr = p[3], hsx = p[4], hsy = p[5];
    var mx = p[6], my = p[7], mw = p[8], mh = p[9];
    var ery = p[10], eo = p[11];
    var bx = p[12], by = p[13], br = p[14], sx = p[15], sy = p[16];
    var la = p[17], ra = p[18];
    var blx = p[19], bly = p[20], bs = p[21], so = p[22], sq = p[23];

    var bodyT = 'translate(' + f(bx) + ' ' + f(by) + ') translate(130 200) rotate(' + f(br) +
      ') scale(' + f(sx) + ' ' + f(sy) + ') translate(-130 -200)';
    el.body.setAttribute('transform', bodyT);
    el.clip.setAttribute('transform', bodyT);

    el.legs.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(' + f(140 + bx * 0.5) + ' 216) scale(' + f(sx) + ' 1) translate(-140 -216)');
    el.legL.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(131 0) scale(' + f(1 + 0.35 * sq) + ' 1) translate(-131 0)');
    el.legR.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(148 0) scale(' + f(1 + 0.1 * sq) + ' 1) translate(-148 0)');
    el.pelvis.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(0 ' + f((1 - sq) * 26) + ')');

    el.belly.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(' + f(blx) + ' ' + f(bly) + ') translate(126 141) scale(' + f(bs) + ') translate(-126 -141)');

    el.armL.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + f(la) + ' 90 70)');
    el.armR.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + f(ra) + ' 166 68)');

    el.shadow.setAttribute('cx', f(127 + hx));
    el.shadow.setAttribute('cy', f(49 + hy + 38 * hsy + 3));
    el.shadow.setAttribute('rx', f(38 * hsx));
    el.shadow.setAttribute('opacity', f(so));

    el.head.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(' + f(hx) + ' ' + f(hy) + ') translate(127 49) rotate(' + f(hr) +
      ') scale(' + f(hsx) + ' ' + f(hsy) + ') translate(-127 -49)');

    el.eyes.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(0 ' + f(ery * 0.35) + ')');
    el.eyes.setAttribute('opacity', f(eo));
    el.eyeR.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(0 ' + f(ery * 0.65) + ')');

    el.mouth.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(' + f(mx) + ' ' + f(my) + ') translate(119 51) scale(' + f(mw) + ' ' + f(mh) +
      ') translate(-119 -51)');
  }

  window.nwb = { render: render };
  render(0);
})();
</script>
